Specialty & 24/7 Animal Emergency
SERVING THE PETS OF PALM BEACH GARDENS, FL SINCE 1994
Pet Emergency and Referral Center has been serving the emergency and specialty veterinary care needs for South Florida's cats and dogs for over 25 years, including Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, North Palm Beach, and surrounding communities.

Outstanding Emergency & Referral Veterinary Care
We are a full-service 24-hour emergency animal hospital and surgical center serving South Florida. We care for dogs and cats and are fully equipped to provide treatment for a wide range of illnesses and injuries. We are open 24 hours every day of the year for emergency care and surgery. Internal medicine, soft tissue surgery, and orthopedic surgery are available by appointment on weekdays.
